title: THE FORCES — the seven drives that mash up the timeline
note: Wrath, War, Greed, Identity, Classism, Wealth Dynamic, Agism. Seven forces, no clean tracks: each feeds the others, all tangled at once. The mashy mishy is the point — history is not seven lines, it is one braid.

forces.name: WRATH
moments: The Ionian Revolt (499–493 BCE) — Greek cities burn Sardis; Persia answers with Marathon
The Persian sack of Athens (480 BCE) — Xerxes burns the city, rage answered with rage
The Peasants' Revolt (1381) — poll tax lights England
The French Revolution (1789) — the storming of the Bastille
The Haitian Revolution (1791) — the enslaved rise
The Paris Commune (1871)
The Arab Spring (2011) — a fruit-seller's self-immolation ignites a region
forces.marker: Every revolution is wrath arriving on schedule.

forces.name: WAR
forces.shape: front: states define themselves at the line
moments: The Bronze Age collapse (c. 1200 BCE) — the Sea Peoples
The Peloponnesian War (431–404 BCE)
The Mongol conquests (1206–1368) — largest contiguous empire
The Thirty Years' War (1618–1648)
The World Wars (1914–1945) — industrial war
Total war's echo: the Cold War (1947–1991)
forces.marker: States make war; war makes states.

forces.name: GREED
forces.shape: accumulation: the hoard that outgrows the holder
moments: The latifundia of Rome — estates swallow the small farms
The South Sea Bubble (1720) — paper greed
The East India Company — corporate extraction as empire
The Robber Barons (1870–1900)
The 2008 financial crisis — leverage as greed's purest form
The Greed Index of this space (ECO-8) — greed located, filed, spotlighted
forces.marker: Greed is the engine the space measures, not preaches against.

forces.name: IDENTITY
forces.engine: the line between us and them
forces.shape: border: who counts, drawn and redrawn
moments: The Persian Wars — Greek vs barbarian, identity forged in fire
The Jewish diaspora — identity carried without land
The Crusades — Christendom vs Dar al-Islam
The Reformation — belief splits the west
Nation-states (1789–1945) — the nation as identity engine
Identity politics (1960s–now) — the line drawn smaller
forces.marker: Identity decides who the war is fought for, and who is looted.

forces.name: CLASSISM
moments: Caste in the Vedic world — rank as cosmic order
The patrician-plebeian struggle in Rome
Serfdom in Europe — the tied laborer
The Three Estates — clergy, nobility, everyone else
The plantation system — race fused to rank
The industrial proletariat — class as the engine of modern politics
forces.marker: Classism is greed wearing a costume of nature.

forces.name: WEALTH DYNAMIC
forces.engine: value moving, or refusing to move
forces.shape: current: flows, dams, floods, and dry beds
moments: Cowrie shells — money before the state
The Lydian coin (c. 600 BCE) — value stamped
The Silk Roads — value in transit
The Atlantic system — wealth on the back of the enslaved
The penny — the space's anchor: weight, honesty, no reserve
The W Token — the old penny stamped, value becoming trust
forces.marker: Every other force leaves its footprint in the flow of value.

forces.name: AGISM
forces.shape: generation: elders hold, youth storm, the cycle turns
moments: The gerontocracy of ancient Sparta — elders rule by design
The Zhou Mandate — the old dynasty loses Heaven's favor
Khaldun's cycle (1377) — asabiyyah decays over three generations: founders, heirs, wastrels
The 1960s youth revolt — the young against the old order
The Boomer-Millennial standoff — age as a class line
The Architect Doctrine (GOV-21) — the founder files for their own exit before dementia
forces.marker: Khaldun proved it: dynasties die of their own generations.

the_braid: Bronze Age collapse (c. 1200 BCE): WAR (Sea Peoples) + IDENTITY (migration) + WEALTH DYNAMIC (trade dies) — the first mash
Roman decline: GREED (tax farming) + CLASSISM (patrician vs plebeian) + WRATH (revolts) + WAR (frontiers fail)
The Crusades: IDENTITY (faith) + WAR (holy war) + GREED (plunder and trade) — the cross and the coin
The Atlantic world: GREED (extraction) + CLASSISM (race as rank) + WEALTH DYNAMIC (chattel as capital) + IDENTITY (who is human)
The Long 19th Century: WAR (Napoleon to 1914) + CLASSISM (proletariat) + WEALTH DYNAMIC (industrial capital) + IDENTITY (nations)
The Present: AGISM (generation war) + IDENTITY (identity politics) + WEALTH DYNAMIC (inequality) + WRATH (populism) + GREED (the Index watches)
